name: bt12-android-vulkan
title: Build targets stage 12 (later goal): the Vulkan renderer on Android
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Stage 12 of section 5. D2 (user, 2026-11-10): native mobile rendering as a later goal.
acceptance: The android target can select Vulkan; the software renderer stays the fallback when the device has no usable Vulkan
Swapchain and surface recreated on pause and resume without leaks or a renderer restart
Image comparison against the software renderer on the emulator in CI; frame rate on a mid-range device recorded
gate: later goal; needs the user's go; depends on bt8-android-player
notes: Reviewer: mobile tiler costs (render pass load/store ops), pre-rotation, validation layers clean on the emulator.
